scope.question: Count source-prompt primary-support shapes, trace explicit round café requests through downstream rewrites and images, census printer support types, and audit current grouped FE publication dependencies.
included: manual inspection of the eight generated images whose source prompt explicitly requests a round café table
printer support descriptions in the existing image-derived placement-judge report
local grouped FE files and locally preserved image equivalents

method.source_shape_rule: Classify explicit round/circular, oval, or rectangular tokens in the first sentence that names the primary support. All other primary supports are unspecified_shape; adjectives such as broad, wide, long, small, or square-to-the-wall alignment do not establish footprint shape.
method.printer_primary_support_rule: Classify the first-sentence support that bears the printer. Secondary cabinets, sideboards, shelves, carts, and cubbies do not change the primary-support class.
method.evidence_separation: Source prompt and rewrite/debug findings are text evidence. Only the eight round-café manual observations are direct image inspection. Placement-judge support descriptions are image-derived model text and are reported separately from direct inspection.

current_grouped_fe_asset_audit.confidence: VERIFIED for local filesystem and hashes; remote publication not checked

grouped_fe.composition: root viewer.html + root data.json + 16 group viewer.html/data.json pairs

publication_dependencies.status: The grouped plan and the general plan are local/dry-run evidence; project state says publication is pending because AWS credentials expired and broker hosts timed out.
publication_dependencies.durability_gap: The grouped FE data points all 160 generated outputs at Pluto endpoint artifact URLs. The grouped publication plan contains no generated-image objects, so the report is not self-contained and depends on those endpoint URLs remaining readable.
publication_dependencies.stable_publication_requirement: Upload the 160 hash-verified local generated PNGs to durable S3 paths and rebuild/rewrite every root and group data.json output image_src to those stable Foundry URLs (or bundle equivalent assets). Then upload the 34 grouped FE objects and 16 twin objects and verify remote metadata/hashes.
publication_dependencies.aws_rule: Any S3 execution must first refresh credentials with /aws-creds and source the resulting environment in the same shell command; this audit performed no upload.

implication_for_revision.confidence: VERIFIED causal evidence within this saved pipeline run
implication_for_revision.finding: Changing only V6.2 source prompt wording cannot make round or oval supports survive this downstream path. The geometry/guide contract and priority rule must represent curved support footprints or allow a requested curved perimeter to override the rectangular guide; otherwise the rewrite will continue to convert the requested shape to a four-corner table.
implication_for_revision.printer_diversity_finding: V6.2 supplies no primary printer-support category diversity: all 80 source rows and all 80 executable rewrites use table-family vocabulary. Cabinet, credenza, shelf, console, or counter supports would require deliberate source-prompt and downstream-geometry support, with printer access and wall placement retained.

limitations: Only the eight explicit round café outputs received direct manual image inspection in this audit.
The 80-row printer rendered-support breakdown uses existing placement-judge text and is not a new human image annotation.
Remote S3 and endpoint availability were not tested; local existence and hashes were tested.
Unspecified_shape means no explicit footprint-shape token in the primary support phrase; it does not imply that the generated image lacks a shape.
